args.text:
Here's what the job involves at the GS-12. If you're picked at a lower grade level, you'll get the chance to learn to do all these duties, and you'll get training to help you grow into the role.

As a TECHNICAL WRITER-EDITOR, you'll:

Handle the contents of documents and of Federal Register publications properly, so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on.

Manage the work, whether you're doing it on your own, as part of the team, or leading others, so every document gets published on time and accurately, and all the program goals get ticked off.

Understand what the customers need across every part of the Federal Register publication process, and sort it out properly, as part of carrying out the Office of the Federal Register's program responsibilities.

Know your way around the technical resources available for, and tied up with, the Federal Register publications processes, and use them properly, including information technology, legacy systems, and other technical resources.

Requirements

Conditions of employment

This opportunity's also open to Status Candidates under Announcement ST-12632063-25-SW.

Have a squiz at that announcement for the details on the open period, eligibility, and how to apply.

Your experience can come from the public sector, the private sector or volunteer work. One year of experience means full-time work; part-time work is counted on a pro rata basis. To make sure you get full credit for your work experience, put your dates of employment as month/day/year, and the number of hours you worked each week, on your CV.

You might have to do a one year probationary period.

You must get through a background investigation.

Fill out a Declaration for Federal Employment, when the agency asks for it, so they can work out whether you're suitable for Federal employment.

If you're a male applicant born after December 31, 1959, you have to certify that you've registered with the Selective Service System or that you're exempt from having to.

Go through a Personal Identity Verification (PIV) process, which needs two forms of identification from the Form i-9. Federal law requires the identity and employment eligibility of all new starters in the U.S. to be verified.

Have a look at "Conditions of Employment."

Hit "Print Preview" to read through the whole announcement before you apply.

Must be U.S. Citizens or U.S. Nationals.

Qualifications

You've got to meet these requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

Specialised Experience: For the GS-09, you must have one year of specialised experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service. Specialised experience for this position includes:

Editing legal or regulatory written documents written by other people, to make sure they stick to the style and formatting requirements before they're developed for publication; AND

Spotting and analysing production problems and coming up with fixes for them; AND

Getting information across well and diplomatically to internal and/or external audiences, to help the program goals along.

OR

EDUCATION: A master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.B. or J.D., if related.

OR

COMBINATION OF EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Note: Only graduate study past the first year (18 semester hours) counts as qualifying for the GS-9.

NOTE: Undergraduate and Graduate Education: Must have included a total of 15 semester hours in an appropriate scientific, technical, or social science field(s), and at least one course above the introductory level in the field(s) the position covers. For technical manuals and specifications writers or editors, the equivalent of 15 semester hours may have come through vocational or educational training above the high school level at a public, private, or Armed Forces school.

Additional information

We might pick from this announcement or any other source to fill one or more vacancies.

This announcement may be used to fill similar positions in other organisations within the National Archives and Records Administration.

This is a bargaining unit position, AFGE Council 260.

There's the chance to work from home, per Agency policy.

There's also the chance of alternative and flexible work schedules, per Agency policy.

result.scope: Issues: flagged phrases, swearing over the cap, US spelling and US words. Warnings: the guide's style rules and swearing density; fidelity to the original (length, names, numbers). Not checked: invented slang.

result.note: No entry. If you're sure Australians say it, it's probably fine but unvetted; otherwise rephrase. Consider proposing it for the dictionary.

results.gloss: Get something finished or passed, just in time or just enough (we got it over the line).
